newsitem.title: USA: NeoRx says two executives resign.
newsitem.headline: NeoRx says two executives resign.

text.p: NeoRx Corp Thursday said Robert Littauer, senior vice president, chief financial officer and treasurer and Jeffrey Miller, senior vice president for business development and legal affairs, resigned to join Ostex International Inc.
In a statement, NeoRx President and Chief Executive Officer Paul Abrams said the company is conducting an "active senior management search.
"We hope to announce two strategic alliances during the fourth quarter which, if completed, will further strengthen our financial position and research and development capabilities," he said.
